title: First Day Home
desc: I was wrapped in a soft white blanket and I was brought home. The house felt different — warmer, fuller, more alive.
story: After five nights in the hospital, we finally drove home with me snug in my car seat. Dad kept looking in the rear-view mirror every 30 seconds. Mum held my tiny hand the whole way. When we walked through the front door for the first time as a family of three, I think they both cried. Happy, overwhelmed, completely in love tears.
